name: Multani
description: Multani is a tree elemental who instinctively animates trees, and later fuses with Yargle to defend Urborg.

description_citations.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

summary.text: Multani is a tree elemental who instinctively animates trees, and later fuses with Yargle to defend Urborg.

citations.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

bio.text: Karn explained that Multani was injured and acted out of instinct.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 8" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2018.

bio.text: Multani rose as a giant of roots and branches, still semiconscious, and Teferi froze him and the trees with time magic.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

bio.text: Chandra used Nissa's visualization to calm him, and he regained awareness and recovered.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

bio.text: Karn promised Multani he would take the Sylex to New Phyrexia and never harm Dominaria.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

bio.text: Muldrotha later called on Multani to fuse with Yargle to defend Urborg against the Phyrexians.

citations.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

status.text: As of the latest story, Multani has fused with Yargle to defend Urborg, and the two remain friends.

citations.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.
"The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Urza's Sylex Blast damages the plane and the sentient forest of Yavimaya traps Multani in its rift.
timeline.quote: instead causing Multani to become trapped in the rift.

citation.text: "Rift", section "Yavimayan rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Venser rescues Multani from the Yavimayan rift and Jeska seals it with Radha's spark, which burns out.
timeline.quote: Radha's spark burned out, causing the warlord to lose her potential to become a planeswalker.

citation.text: "Rift", section "Yavimayan rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani transplants a piece of Yavimaya's forest onto Urborg.
timeline.quote: transplanted on the island by Multani

citation.text: "The Domains", section "Locations in the Domains". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani taught Gerrard, Mirri and Rofellos to hone spellcasting alongside physical discipline.
timeline.quote: Multani taught Gerrard, Mirri, and Rofellos to hone their spellcasting in tandem with more physical disciplines

citation.text: Multani (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard trains under Multani and befriends Rofellos and Mirri.
timeline.quote: Here he befriended the elf Rofellos and the cat -warrior Mirri .

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Childhood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mirri becomes a student of Multani and befriends Gerrard and Rofellos, falling in love with Gerrard.
timeline.quote: she eventually became a student of Multani and a friend to Gerrard Capashen and Rofellos

citation.text: "Mirri", section "Time with Multani". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: K'rrik destroys Urza's academy on Tolaria despite Karn's time travel; Urza later defeats K'rrik with Multani's help.
timeline.quote: K'rrik succeeded in destroying the place, but Urza sent the silver golem Karn back in time to prevent this.

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Lord of the Wastes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza comes to Yavimaya for allies; Multani, knowing Urza destroyed Argoth, imprisons him in a living tree and makes him feel the land's pain.
timeline.quote: Multani used Yavimaya's magic to disorientate him, imprison him in a living tree, and make him feel the pain of the land

citation.text: "Multani", section "Timestreams". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani, still in Urza's mind, infuses him with energy so Urza can kill K'rrick at Tolaria.
timeline.quote: allowing Urza to kill K'rrick by teleporting inside of him

citation.text: "Multani", section "Timestreams". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Yavimaya Multani, remembering Argoth's devastation, ensorcells Urza in a tree for three years.
timeline.quote: Urza apologizes but is ensorcelled by Multani until he is encased in a tree

citation.text: "Time Streams", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin's beacon wakes Urza; Multani sees Urza protecting life, and the two kill K’rrik and destroy the Negators.
timeline.quote: Multani animates Tolaria's forests and the remaining negators are destroyed.

citation.text: "Time Streams", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Invasion of Tolaria is ended by Barrin, students, Jhoira, Teferi and Shiv allies.
timeline.quote: the Invasion of Tolaria began, with K'rrik 's negators swarming over the island

citation.text: "Tolarian Academy", section "The Invasion of Tolaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani tells Urza to make peace with him to make peace with the forest.
timeline.quote: To make peace with the forest, make peace with me.

citation.text: Multani, Maro-Sorcerer (Urza's Legacy, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Multani vows Yavimaya will not share Argoth's fate.
timeline.quote: Yavimaya will not share that fate.

citation.text: Wing Snare (Urza's Legacy, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Multani and Urza become allies and Yavimaya strengthens against Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: After this Multani and Urza became allies.

citation.text: "Multani", section "Bloodlines". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yavimaya recruits the elf Rofellos as a new avatar, but he cannot cope and Multani returns.
timeline.quote: Eventually, though, Rofellos couldn't cope with being the avatar of a living forest and Multani returned to take that place.

citation.text: "Multani", section "Bloodlines". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: When Vuel starts his war against his brother, Multani goes into hiding, leaving his students to think he is dead.
timeline.quote: Multani went into hiding

citation.text: "Multani", section "Bloodlines". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani traps Urza in a magnigoth tree at Yavimaya and forces him to feel Titania's pain.
timeline.quote: trapped Urza in a magnigoth tree and forced him to experience all the pain Titania

citation.text: "Urza", section "Atonement for Past Sins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin saves Urza, Multani becomes trapped within him, and Multani later helps destroy Kerrick and his Negators during the Invasion of Tolaria.
timeline.quote: Multani aided Urza in destroying Kerrick and all his minions

citation.text: "Urza", section "Atonement for Past Sins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rofellos arrives in Yavimaya to build its defenses and exchanges places with Multani as voice of the forest, freeing Multani to travel.
timeline.quote: he exchanged places with Multani as voice of Yavimaya, allowing Multani to go abroad in the world.

citation.text: "Yavimaya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza journeys to Yavimaya to enlist aid against the Phyrexians and is taken captive by Multani; his consciousness merges with the forest's for a time.
timeline.quote: Urza was then taken captive by the forest's emissary, Multani.

citation.text: "Yavimaya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Phyrexian Invasion, Multani transplants part of Yavimaya to Urborg's edge for the last great battle.
timeline.quote: Multani transplanted part of Yavimaya to Urborg 's edge

citation.text: "Yavimaya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani tells Rofellos they are both of Gaea and equal.
timeline.quote: We are both of Gaea, and thus we are equal.

citation.text: Rofellos's Gift (Urza's Destiny, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Rofellos teaches Yavimaya's elves vulgar words to Multani's chagrin.
timeline.quote: Rofellos gleefully tutored Yavimaya's elves

citation.text: Taunting Elf (Urza's Destiny, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The enraged spirit of Multani casts out the Yavimayan elves.
timeline.quote: Cast out by the enraged spirit of Multani

citation.text: "Elf", section "Yavimayan Elves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians in Yavimaya are killed and resurrected as woodmen fighting for the forest.
timeline.quote: the Phyrexians there are killed and resurrected as woodmen that fight for the forest.

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Phyrexian Invasion Multani's magic revives the Kavu, who go about fighting the war.
timeline.quote: During the Phyrexian Invasion , Multani 's magic revived them, and they immediately went about fighting the war.

citation.text: "Kavu", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Phyrexian invasion Multani senses Eladamri as the perfect leader and travels across the oceans to find him.
timeline.quote: that creature was Eladamri who was currently saving elves in Llanowar

citation.text: "Multani", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani reunites with Gerrard and places his mind inside the Weatherlight to fight the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Multani placed his mind inside the flying ship

citation.text: "Multani", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the battle of Urborg the Weatherlight is destroyed by the Primevals; Karn has it reborn with the Thran Tome, giving it a consciousness that displaces Multani.
timeline.quote: Karn was able to use the Thran Tome to have the ship reborn

citation.text: "Multani", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani transplants a section of Yavimaya and its defenders to Urborg, spending nearly all his power and disappearing.
timeline.quote: Multani transplanted a few miles of Yavimaya and several of its most powerful defenders to Urborg

citation.text: "Multani", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yavimaya, led by Multani with Gaea's support, destroys or transforms every invading Phyrexian.
timeline.quote: The result was a total defeat for Phyrexia

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "First stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Llanowar is defended by Molimo, Multani and the Weatherlight crew, with great losses including King Fhedusil and Takara en-Dal.
timeline.quote: they succeeded in repelling the Phyrexians with immense effort

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "First stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani overlays Yavimaya's forest onto Urborg with Gaea's help to move its defenders.
timeline.quote: Multani gathered the trees in a five-mile radius

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Final stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani transplants part of Yavimaya to Urborg's edge for the last great battle, in whose skies Yawgmoth is finally defeated.
timeline.quote: It was in the skies over Urborg that Yawgmoth was finally defeated

citation.text: "Urborg", section "First Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani observes Rath's overlay interfering with the Aether.
timeline.quote: Rath's overlay is interfering with the Æther itself.

citation.text: Horned Kavu (Planeshift, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Multani transplants Yavimaya to Urborg's edge.
timeline.quote: Multani had transplanted Yavimaya to Urborg's edge.

citation.text: Jungle Barrier (Apocalypse, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Multani's troops invade Urborg.
timeline.quote: As Multani's troops invaded Urborg

citation.text: Consume Strength (Apocalypse, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Multani returns to Yavimaya, learns other lands have fallen, and transplants part of Yavimaya onto Urborg, driving Crovax from his throne room.
timeline.quote: He flees to regroup his army.

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin's forces are overrun in the Invasion of Tolaria while Multani holds Urza prisoner in Yavimaya.
timeline.quote: Barrin's forces were finally overrun in the Invasion of Tolaria

citation.text: "K'rrik", section "K'rrik's fate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani lends Urza his strength and together they kill K'rrik; Multani animates Tolaria's forests to destroy the remaining negators.
timeline.quote: Multani lent Urza his strength and killed the Phyrexian together

citation.text: "K'rrik", section "K'rrik's fate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani bonds Radha to Yavimaya, restoring her green mana, and Jeska uses her to close the Yavimaya rift.
timeline.quote: Jeska then used Radha again to close the rift in Yavimaya.

citation.text: "Radha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Yavimaya a vision from Leshrac makes Jeska immolate Multani's physical form, and she then closes the rift.
timeline.quote: caused Jeska to break the connection and immolate

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Leshrac takes over Jeska's mind and uses her and Radha to close the rifts in Yavimaya and Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: Leshrac managed to get hold of Jeska's mind

citation.text: "Leshrac", section "Leshrac's Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karona summons several people thought of as gods, Multani among them.
timeline.quote: The goddess Karona was looking for people similar to her and summoned several people thought of as gods, Multani among them.

citation.text: "Multani", section "100 years after the Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the temporal crisis a rift in Yavimaya suspends Multani; he imprisons Venser in a tree to ask for help.
timeline.quote: Multani imprisoned Venser in a tree in a similar manner as with Urza long ago, to ask for help.

citation.text: "Multani", section "Temporal Crisis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani bonds Radha to the forest, restoring her green mana, and hypnotizes Jeska.
timeline.quote: He also created a new bond between Radha and the forest

citation.text: "Multani", section "Temporal Crisis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska awakens and blasts Multani's physical body to smithereens, then uses Radha and his mask to seal the rift, diminishing his essence.
timeline.quote: Jeska awakened and blasted Multani's physical body to smithereens.

citation.text: "Multani", section "Temporal Crisis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska burns out Radha's inherited spark, closing the Yavimaya rift but temporarily destroying Multani.
timeline.quote: burning out the spark Radha had unknowingly inherited

citation.text: "Temporal Crisis of Dominaria", section "Resolution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi, Jhoira and Venser find Multani incapacitated by the Yavimaya rift.
timeline.quote: Venser can planeswalk into the rift and free Multani

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska seals the Yavimayan rift through Radha and Multani's mask, leaving the mask inert; Jhoira buries it.
timeline.quote: Jhoira buries Multani's mask in the hopes that he can someday be revived

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani's mind grasped for consciousness as rage rebuilt his body.
timeline.quote: Multani's mind grasped for consciousness as rage itself rebuilt his body.

citation.text: Ancient Animus (Dominaria, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sixty years after the Mending Multani awakens, and Chandra Nalaar restores him to consciousness.
timeline.quote: He was restored to consciousness by Chandra Nalaar

citation.text: "Multani", section "Return and offspring". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Muldrotha, Multani's child, is born into Yavimaya's offshoot on Urborg.
timeline.quote: Multani's child Muldrotha had been born into Yavimaya's offshoot on Urborg

citation.text: "Multani", section "Return and offspring". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sixty years after the Mending, Multani's mind awakens in rage and Muldrotha is born on Urborg.
timeline.quote: his child Muldrotha was born into Yavimaya's offshoot on Urborg

citation.text: "Yavimaya", section "Revival". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cast out by Multani's raging spirit, the Yavimayan elves live as exiles.
timeline.quote: Cast out by the raging spirit of Multani, Yavimayan elves had to live as exiles on the outskirts of their former home.

citation.text: "Yavimaya", section "Revival". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani calms and the elves return to Yavimaya.
timeline.quote: Now that Multani has calmed, the elves are free to return to Yavimaya.

citation.text: "Yavimaya", section "Revival". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The automaton says Multani animated the trees.
timeline.quote: They're animated trees, created and sent by Multani.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 8" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Karn explains Multani is injured and acts out of instinct.
timeline.quote: Multani is an elemental, and has been in a semiconscious state

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 8" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Multani rises as a giant of roots and branches, and Karn says he is still semiconscious.
timeline.quote: He's still semiconscious. He would never hurt us if he were himself.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi freezes Multani and the trees with time magic from the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: "It's time magic."

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Chandra uses Nissa's visualization to calm Multani, who regains awareness and recovers.
timeline.quote: The angry gold light from his eyes and mouth faded to a deep blue, and she was sure she saw awareness there.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Karn promises Multani he will take the Sylex to New Phyrexia and never harm Dominaria.
timeline.quote: It will never harm Dominaria, I swear it.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Chandra practices concentration with thirty-seven fireballs while Jaya says what the Multani episode showed her.
timeline.quote: It was the first indication I'd ever seen that you were capable of concentrating on something for any length of time.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Multani greets Yargle, saying his daughter has shown him the merit in Urborg's ways.
timeline.quote: "I've heard much about you from my daughter," Multani rumbled.

citation.text: Yargle and Multani (March of the Machine, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Urza teleports in from Yavimaya with Multani's spirit and seals wells and repairs walls.
timeline.quote: Urza teleported in from his imprisonment in Yavimaya carrying the spirit of Multani with him.

citation.text: "Invasion of Tolaria", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Empowered by Multani, Urza planeswalks into K'rrik's body, destroying him.
timeline.quote: Urza planeswalked directly into K'rrik's body, destroying him from within in an explosive burst of flesh and oil.

citation.text: "Invasion of Tolaria", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza cleanses the remaining chambers, allying with Multani.
timeline.quote: solidifying an alliance with the forest spirit.

citation.text: "Invasion of Tolaria", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Muldrotha's plea Multani binds himself to Yargle to grant resistance to glistening oil during the new Phyrexian invasion.
timeline.quote: Multani bound himself to Yargle

citation.text: "Multani", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Muldrotha calls on Multani to fuse with Yargle to defend Urborg against the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: it was Muldrotha who called upon her father, Multani, to fuse with Yargle and aid in its defense of Urborg.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Jaeuhl Carthalion and Kaysa lead Fyndhorn survivors to Yavimaya and make peace with Multani.
timeline.quote: led the Fyndhorn survivors to Yavimaya

citation.text: "Flooding of Terisiare", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani forms a new Weatherlight figurehead in the form of Gaea, using Hanna's features.
timeline.quote: Multani formed a new figurehead for the Skyship Weatherlight in the form of Gaea

citation.text: "Gaea", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Freyalise's World Spell, Multani awakens in darkness and uses the Heart's vines to drive off or kill sentient life.
timeline.quote: Multani , the spirit of Yavimaya, awoke in darkness and used the Heart's vines to kill sentient life

citation.text: "Heart of Yavimaya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 3357 AR Multani excises the Weatherseed and gifts it to Urza; the Weatherlight's hull grows from it.
timeline.quote: Multani excised a piece of the tree's core, called the Weatherseed

citation.text: "Heart of Yavimaya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Phyrexian Invasion the Heart is badly wounded, but Multani saves it and turns dead Phyrexians into wood elementals.
timeline.quote: but Multani saved it, turning the dead Phyrexians into wood elementals

citation.text: "Heart of Yavimaya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nemata and the magnigoths travel from Yavimaya to Urborg to recapture Rith; the lead treefolk swallows her.
timeline.quote: The lead treefolk ripped her out of the sky and swallowed her before returning to Yavimaya.

citation.text: "Nemata", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rofellos is sent to Yavimaya and exchanges places with Multani as the voice of the forest.
timeline.quote: he exchanged places with Multani as the voice of Yavimaya

citation.text: "Rofellos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rofellos steps down as Yavimaya's avatar; Multani offers to teach him Maro-Sorcery.
timeline.quote: Rofellos stepped down

citation.text: "Rofellos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rofellos studies with Gerrard and Mirri under Multani, then joins the Weatherlight crew with Mirri.
timeline.quote: Rofellos and Mirri offered to come along as well

citation.text: "Rofellos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Muldrotha pleads with her father; Multani binds himself to Yargle to grant resistance to the oil.
timeline.quote: Multani bound himself to Yargle, using his powers and existing knowledge of Phyrexia to grant increased resistance to glistening oil.

citation.text: "Yargle", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the invasion Multani and Muldrotha gain grudging respect for Yargle.
timeline.quote: Multani and Muldrotha gained a grudging respect for the bizarre monster

citation.text: "Yargle", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
